content:
eva_csm: quick FYI  last night a small subset of trial onboarding flows experienced intermittent auth 401s and slowed embedding responses. Need a short interim customer update and a prioritized outreach list for renewals.

nate_ops: Investigating. Early signal: aggressive cache trimming during a write burst caused token eviction for some sessions; retries amplified load. Rolled back trimming tweak and added a temporary retry backoff. Monitoring looks stable.

incident_bot: Hotfix deployed by nate_ops at 2026-02-11T23:05Z  canary checks passing.

yara_support: CS  please surface impacted tenants + renewal windows so we can split high-touch vs standard outreach.

eva_csm: Pulling list. High-touch / renewal <45d: Aventis Health, Mosaic Labs, QuantaShop. Mid: ParcelGrid, DraftDocs. Low: BeaconOps.

leo_sales: For high-touch recommend exec escalation + 1-month credit OR 6 hours of engineering onboarding support + two priority enablement sessions. Confirm finance?

gina_finance: We can pre-approve one-month credits for trials flagged as priority. Please include explicit credit application text: "one-month credit applied to your next invoice or refunded on request." Log under CS-11021.

nate_ops: Customer-facing tech blurb: a cache trimming configuration interacted with an onboarding traffic spike, causing premature token eviction and transient auth failures (401). We reverted the change, added cache headroom and a client retry backoff, and are monitoring. Full RCA with timeline to follow.

eva_csm: Draft interim message for review:

"Hi <Customer>,

Were writing to let you know about a transient service issue on 2026-02-11 that may have affected onboarding flows. You may have seen authentication errors (401) or delayed embedding responses.

What happened (short): A background cache trimming change combined with a burst of onboarding traffic caused some token state to be evicted prematurely, leading to retries and slowed responses for a subset of tenants.

What we did: We reverted the change, deployed a hotfix to add cache headroom and a short client retry backoff, and are monitoring closely.

Next steps & support: We will deliver a full RCA within 72 hours. Affected trial customers flagged as priority will receive a one-month service credit (applied to your next invoice or refunded on request) or equivalent engineering support hours. If youre in an active renewal window, we will prioritize your environment for 30 days and schedule priority enablement sessions.

If you observed an issue, please reply with any example request IDs and approximate times so we can correlate logs.

Sincerely,
Redwood Customer Success"

leo_sales: LGTM. Add: "we know this can impact evaluation; your AE will follow up within 24 hours."

yara_support: I'll start targeted outreach to the list and request request IDs when we send the note.

eva_csm: Plan: send interim note to impacted trials in 60 minutes; exec outreach for top 3 within 2 hours; full RCA in 72 hours; prioritized enablement scheduled within 7 days. Proceed? React with :thumbsup:.

nate_ops: :thumbsup:

yara_support: :thumbsup:

incident_bot: Incident classified P2. Next automated update scheduled in 2 hours.
